user.title: Connect Hao Deng account
user.description: Your Hao Deng app login is used once to download the mesh credentials and the list of lights. The login itself is not stored; afterwards everything runs locally via Bluetooth.

place.title: Select place
place.description: Your account has several places. Each place is its own mesh network; add the others afterwards as separate entries.
